primary-ink.displayName: Primary ink — blue-700, brand text on light

focus-blue-dark.displayName: Focus blue, dark — blue-400, ring and brand text in dark

info-tint.displayName: Informational tint — blue-50, state not brand

panel.displayName: Panel — gray-50, sidebar panel, table header, hover

tile.displayName: Tile — gray-100, avatar and mono chip background

control-border.displayName: Control border — gray-300, input and secondary button border

icon-muted.displayName: Icon muted — gray-500, lightest text ever gets

text-secondary.displayName: Text secondary — gray-600, helper text, table headers

text-idle.displayName: Text idle — gray-700, body on tinted surfaces, idle nav

display.purpose: The largest the product gets; steps down to Title size below lg.

secondary.purpose: Nav rows, menu items, helper text.

caption.purpose: Labels, pills, chips, counts, table headers.

mono.purpose: Identifiers only: hex values, permission keys, ids, chips like THIS DEVICE. Uppercase with wide tracking.

shadows.name: menu
shadows.purpose: Dropdown and user menus — the smaller of the two floating shadows.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, sheets, slide-overs, and the navigation drawer. Nothing resting casts a shadow.

motion.name: ease-out-standard
motion.purpose: The only easing; state transitions run 150-220ms, no bounce, no scale.

motion.name: motion-safe-gate
motion.purpose: Every transition and animation is written under motion-safe: (or paired with a motion-reduce: reset); prefers-reduced-motion collapses everything to no motion.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Dialogs center as 480px cards; sheets become right slide-overs.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Tables return from card lists; page gutter grows to 24px.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar becomes permanent at 240px; nav rows drop from 44px touch targets to 40/32px.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The brand fill; one per view at most is typical. Hover is the same color at 90% opacity, never a derived shade.

components.name: Secondary Button

components.name: Danger Button

components.name: Input

narrative.northStar: None, by design — the fixed base layer carries no editorial personality; visual identity is each tenant's contribution through the customizable layer.
narrative.overview:
This is the fixed base token layer — what every tenant starts from and what no tenant can change. The layer deliberately carries no editorial personality: visual identity is each tenant's contribution through the one customizable brand color and the approved font list, so the fixed layer stays neutral enough to sit under any of them. The values shown are reference defaults, not brand choices — blue-600 stands in for the shadcn --primary variable that Branding fills per request.

The voice is calm utility. A white page, a soft gray sidebar panel with rounded corners, hairline borders, rounded rows and pills, generous air between things. The work is the loudest element on screen; polish lives in precision (measured contrast values, one focus ring, one height scale) rather than decoration. Depth is conveyed by hairlines and tonal steps, not shadow. The system is thumb-first and forgiving: every screen is designed at phone width before any wider layout, controls keep 44px touch targets under 1024px, and phone flows use bottom sheets rather than shrunken desktops.

Authority chain: docs/design/design-system/tokens.md is the source of truth for the fixed layer; where a reference component or capture disagrees, the token file wins. The defaults must look good and well designed on their own — tenant overrides sit on top of good defaults and never excuse them.
keyCharacteristics: Mobile-first utility: phone layout is the base; tables become card lists under 768px, inspectors become sheets
One tenant accent, used sparingly: primary button, count pill, active nav row, focus ring — nothing else
Hairline borders over shadows; only menus and overlays cast shadows
Plus Jakarta Sans everywhere; JetBrains Mono stamps identifiers
Thumb-first controls: one height scale (32/40/44px), 44px minimum touch targets under 1024px
Motion is 150–220ms ease-out, no bounce, no scale, always motion-safe: gated
WCAG 2.1 AA with measured contrast pinned in the token file (ring 3.68:1 on white, input border 4.89:1)

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: The tenant color appears in exactly four places: the primary button, the count pill, the active navigation row's text and icon, and the focus ring. The sidebar panel and the page chrome never take it.

rules.name: The No-Ramp Rule
rules.body: No tint ramp is derived from the tenant color. A hover or active state is the same color at reduced opacity — 90% on hover, 80% on press — never a derived shade. An identity or label surface (avatar, monogram tile, label pill) stays fixed neutral gray.

rules.name: The State-vs-Label Rule
rules.body: A tint that carries state or meaning keeps its blue and is not brand: a selected table row, an informational notice. A pill that labels a thing (Admin portal, Notice, counts, type labels, kind, source) is gray or blue, never a status color. The test is whether the tenant's color would be wrong there.

rules.name: The No Arbitrary Pixels Rule
rules.body: The scale is the Tailwind type utilities and nothing else. Any text-[13.5px] or text-[Npx] is forbidden in every component — grep -rn "text-\[[0-9.]*px\]" src must return nothing.

rules.name: The Root-Follows-the-Preset Rule
rules.body: The tenant font-size preset sets the root font size to 14, 15, or 16px, and the rem-based scale follows the root without per-component changes. Control heights do not follow it: they are fixed pixels at every preset, so a touch target keeps its size when a tenant picks Compact.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: A resting surface gets a border, not a shadow. If it is not a menu or an overlay, it does not cast.

dos: Do apply the one shared focusRing constant to every interactive element — 2px opaque blue-500 ring at 2px offset (blue-400 in dark) — and never write outline: none without it.
Do keep every interactive row and icon button at least 44px tall under 1024px (min-h-11 lg:min-h-0); give 32px controls invisible padding to reach 44 by 44.
Do write every transition-* and animate-* utility under motion-safe: (or pair a motion-reduce: reset).
Do route every destructive path through the shared ConfirmDialog with Cancel focused by default.
Do turn every table into a card list under 768px — one card per row, actions in an overflow menu, no horizontal scrolling.
Do use the loading state for any action that leaves the page or waits on the network.
donts: Don't derive any tint, shade, or ramp from the tenant color; hover is 90% opacity of the same color, press is 80%.
Don't use arbitrary text sizes (text-[13.5px], any text-[Npx]) in any component.
Don't put a shadow on a resting surface; hairline borders separate, and shadows belong to menus and overlays.
Don't give a label pill a status color, and don't use emoji as icons — Lucide only, stroke 1.75.
Don't add a bell or notification button to the header; notifications surface only through the Inbox nav item and its count pill.
Don't use near-black fills, sharp corners, or left-edge accent rules; the dark theme is gray-950 surfaces with hairline borders.
